resources.string:
This locally written example is never sent automatically to AI or a computer.

## 1 Write and ask
Write in a blank area, select a clear region, and ask the model you choose.

## 2 Share
Export a PDF from the Share menu to let others read the current page.

## 3 Send to a computer
First connect an Agent and scan the pairing code in the desktop assistant. Then choose Send to Agent from a note. You can keep writing after submission and check the result later in Computer Tasks.
